findings.title: CVE-2026-113380 Signal RingRTC FSM queue resource consumption — VulDB
findings.summary_md: VulDB entry records the advisory disclosure on 10/20/2026, notes upgrade to RingRTC 2.72.0, and describes a peer saturating the call FSM queue to interfere with hangup teardown, affecting audio and possibly video.

findings.title: CVE-2026-113380 — Threat Radar (CWE-754)
findings.summary_md: Threat Radar lists publication 10/20/2026 04:25:10 UTC, assigns CWE-754, and describes the same RingRTC queue-saturation mechanism that lets a malicious peer block local hangup steps in Signal before version 2.72.0.
